rules.title: Housing discrimination ban including source of income
rules.requirement: Owners of housing accommodations may not discriminate against or harass any person because of protected characteristics, including source of income. Source of income means lawful, verifiable income paid to or on behalf of a tenant, including public assistance and housing subsidies such as Section 8 vouchers.
rules.coverage_text: The owner of any housing accommodation.
rules.exemptions: Making a written or oral inquiry concerning the level or source of income is not discrimination based on source of income.
rules.quoted_span: (a) For the owner of any housing accommodation to discriminate against or harass any person because of the race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, familial status, source of income, disability, veteran or military status, or genetic information of that person.

rules.title: Ban on inquiries about protected characteristics
rules.requirement: Owners may not make or cause to be made any written or oral inquiry about protected characteristics (such as race, religion, disability or familial status) of any person seeking to rent or lease housing. An inquiry about the level or source of income is not source-of-income discrimination.
rules.coverage_text: The owner of any housing accommodation, as to persons seeking to purchase, rent, or lease any housing accommodation.
rules.exemptions: It does not constitute discrimination based on source of income to make a written or oral inquiry concerning the level or source of income.
rules.quoted_span: (b) For the owner of any housing accommodation to make or to cause to be made any written or oral inquiry concerning the race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, familial status, disability, veteran or military status, or genetic information of any person

rules.title: Aggregate income of co-residents in income standards
rules.requirement: A financial or income standard used in renting housing must account for the aggregate income of persons residing or proposing to reside together on the same basis as the aggregate income of married persons.
rules.quoted_span: (n) To use a financial or income standard in the rental of housing that fails to account for the aggregate income of persons residing together or proposing to reside together on the same basis as the aggregate income

rules.title: Income standard limited to tenant's portion of subsidized rent
rules.requirement: Where there is a government rent subsidy, a financial or income standard used to assess rental eligibility must be based on the portion of the rent to be paid by the tenant.
rules.coverage_text: Rentals in instances in which there is a government rent subsidy.
rules.exemptions: Does not limit the owner's ability to request information or documentation to verify employment, to request landlord references, or to verify the identity of a person.
rules.quoted_span: (A) Use a financial or income standard in assessing eligibility for the rental of housing that is not based on the portion of the rent to be paid by the tenant.

rules.title: Credit history alternative evidence for subsidized applicants
rules.requirement: Where there is a government rent subsidy, a housing provider may not use an applicant's credit history without offering the option to provide lawful, verifiable alternative evidence of ability to pay the tenant's portion of rent (such as government benefit payments, pay records, bank statements). If the applicant elects this, the provider must give reasonable time to respond and reasonably consider that evidence in lieu of credit history.
rules.coverage_text: Rental applications in instances in which there is a government rent subsidy.
rules.exemptions: Does not limit the owner's ability to request information or documentation to verify employment, to request landlord references, or to verify the identity of a person.
rules.quoted_span: (B) (i) Use a person’s credit history as part of the application process for a rental accommodation without offering the applicant the option, at the applicant’s discretion, of providing lawful, verifiable alternative evidence of the applicant’s reasonable ability to pay
